{
 "path": "programs/task-eac20715.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row}

    # Grid-line color is the color forming long, nearly uniform horizontal
    # and vertical separator lines; marker cells may interrupt those lines.
    def stripe_score(c):
        rows = sum(sum(v == c for v in row) / w >= 0.70 for row in grid)
        cols = sum(sum(grid[r][j] == c for r in range(h)) / h >= 0.70 for j in range(w))
        return rows + cols

    line = max(colors, key=stripe_score)
    boundary_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid)
                     if sum(v == line for v in row) / w >= 0.70]
    boundary_cols = [j for j in range(w)
                     if sum(grid[i][j] == line for i in range(h)) / h >= 0.70]
    if len(boundary_rows) < 2 or len(boundary_cols) < 2:
        return grid

    # Non-line colors at separator intersections are the encoded markers.
    marker_cols = [j for j in boundary_cols
                   if any(grid[i][j] != line for i in boundary_rows)]
    if not marker_cols:
        return grid
    background = max(colors - {line}, key=lambda c: sum(v == c for row in grid for v in row))

    # Markers occur in adjacent pairs. Each pair encodes one vertical trace;
    # an unmarked interval between traces becomes a background column.
    pairs = []
    k = 0
    while k < len(marker_cols):
        if k + 1 < len(marker_cols):
            pairs.append((marker_cols[k], marker_cols[k + 1]))
            k += 2
        else:
            pairs.append((marker_cols[k], marker_cols[k]))
            k += 1

    out = []
    for r1, r2 in zip(boundary_rows, boundary_rows[1:]):
        row_out = []
        for p, (c1, c2) in enumerate(pairs):
            if p:
                row_out.append(background)
            a = grid[r1][c1]
            b = grid[r2][c1]
            row_out.append(a if a == b and a != line else background)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out
"
}

{
 "path": "programs/task-eac20715.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {x for row in grid for x in row}

    def stripe_score(c):
        return (sum(sum(x == c for x in row) / w >= 0.7 for row in grid) +
                sum(sum(grid[r][j] == c for r in range(h)) / h >= 0.7 for j in range(w)))

    line = max(colors, key=stripe_score)
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(x == line for x in grid[r]) / w >= 0.7]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line for r in range(h)) / h >= 0.7]
    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return grid

    bg = max(colors - {line}, key=lambda c: sum(x == c for row in grid for x in row))
    out = []
    for r1, r2 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        line_out = []
        for c1, c2 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = [grid[r1][c1], grid[r1][c2], grid[r2][c1], grid[r2][c2]]
            v = corners[0]
            line_out.append(v if v != line and all(x == v for x in corners) else bg)
        out.append(line_out)

    # Discard outer blank lattice cells while preserving blank cells enclosed
    # between marked cells.
    nonblank_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(out) if any(x != bg for x in row)]
    nonblank_cols = [c for c in range(len(out[0])) if any(out[r][c] != bg for r in range(len(out)))]
    if not nonblank_rows or not nonblank_cols:
        return [[bg]]
    return [row[nonblank_cols[0]:nonblank_cols[-1] + 1]
            for row in out[nonblank_rows[0]:nonblank_rows[-1] + 1]]
"
}
